articles.title_en: Ukrainian drones strike Russian port, killing 1 and setting oil refinery on fire
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones struck the port of Tuapse overnight on April 20, killing one person and injuring another, Krasnodar Krai Governor Veniamin Kondratyev said. A fire broke out at the seaport, he wrote on social media.
